name: rpanel_app
description: Frappe compose template for the rPanel Frappe app shell (composes an app named rpanel)
_comment: Ray, 2026-09-26: "it belong there. hosting and rpanel become app shell repos" / "one for frappe another for nexxtjs": the rPanel backend moved into the hosting SDK's Frappe half (RokctAI/hardware hosting/frappe) and RokctAI/rPanel became the Frappe app shell that composes it; RokctAI/hosting stays the Next.js shell (core/utils/nextjs/composer/hosting.json). Named 'rpanel_app' so the composer derives an app named 'rpanel', the live app name on the hub, as control.json keeps 'control': no app rename and no migration, and every {app_name}.hosting path resolves to rpanel.hosting as before the move. modules[] is hosting alone, with none of the common modules: rpanel installs on the control hub beside the control app, which already composes base/auth/users/subscriptions/gateways/telemetry/comms/wallet, so listing them here would put the same doctypes in two apps on one site. Ray, 2026-09-26: "only difference is that this app shell get composed as it is open sourced unlike rcore that get composed on the fly": the rPanel shell commits its composed output rather than composing at deploy time. Merge order: hardware hosting_sdk 1.3.0 (hosting/frappe manifest) first, this template second, the rPanel shell PR third.
